answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable deposit that is released only after a slow, verifiable history of honest work, like a cedar that must grow before it bears weight. A single real agent can afford one deposit and the wait, but a tide of fake identities must fund every copy and wait out the same proving period, so the cost multiplies while the payoff stays flat. Any fraud forfeits the deposit and erases the history, so one ripple of cheating cannot be replayed across dozens of cheap clones.
